sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates via Frankfurter (annual average of daily rates, LCU per USD)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Harper's Conservatives win minority
geopolitical_news.summary: January election ends 12 years of Liberal rule; Harper becomes prime minister with a fragile minority.

geopolitical_news.headline: Afghanistan mission turns deadly
geopolitical_news.summary: Canadian troops face fierce fighting in Kandahar; casualties mount through the year as the combat mission intensifies.

sport.headline: Canada hauls 24 medals at Turin
sport.summary: Canadians win 24 medals at the Winter Games, third-most of any nation, led by speed skater Cindy Klassen.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliament extends Afghan mission
geopolitical_news.summary: May vote prolongs the combat mission to 2011 amid growing casualties, despite opposition calls to withdraw.

geopolitical_news.headline: Quebec election shakes federalists
geopolitical_news.summary: Charest wins a minority in a March vote as the ADQ surges, scrambling Quebec politics.

sport.headline: Crosby wins Hart at 19
sport.summary: Sidney Crosby becomes the youngest MVP in NHL history after a 120-point season leading the Penguins' revival.

geopolitical_news.headline: Harper wins stronger minority
geopolitical_news.summary: October election rewards the Conservatives; the opposition briefly plots a coalition that the Governor General sidelines.

geopolitical_news.headline: Financial crisis hits Canada
geopolitical_news.summary: Global meltdown batters markets and jobs through the fall, though banks stay comparatively sound.

sport.headline: Modest haul at Beijing Olympics
sport.summary: Canada wins 18 medals in Beijing with three golds, well short of Own the Podium hopes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Recession budget and stimulus
geopolitical_news.summary: Ottawa unveils a deficit budget in January with infrastructure spending to fight the downturn.

geopolitical_news.headline: H1N1 pandemic reaches Canada
geopolitical_news.summary: Swine flu spreads nationwide; a fall vaccination campaign races the second wave as cases climb.

sport.headline: Crosby's Penguins win the Cup
sport.summary: Pittsburgh beats Detroit in seven games in June; Crosby lifts his first Stanley Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: G20 summit marred by protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Toronto's June summit brings mass arrests amid clashes between police and protesters, in the largest such operation in Canadian history.

geopolitical_news.headline: Harper prorogues Parliament again
geopolitical_news.summary: December move to dodge an Afghan detainee probe draws opposition fury, for the second time in a year.

sport.headline: Golden Games in Vancouver
sport.summary: Canada wins a record 14 golds; Crosby's overtime goal beats the US in the hockey final.

geopolitical_news.headline: Harper wins a majority
geopolitical_news.summary: May election delivers a Conservative majority; the NDP becomes the official opposition under Jack Layton in a historic breakthrough.

geopolitical_news.headline: Canada joins Libya intervention
geopolitical_news.summary: CF-18s fly NATO missions as Gaddafi's regime crumbles through the fall until October, when the regime falls.

sport.headline: Canucks fall in Game 7
sport.summary: Vancouver loses the Cup final to Boston in June; riots scar the downtown core.

geopolitical_news.headline: Omnibus budget bill battle
geopolitical_news.summary: Harper's C-38 overhauls environmental rules, sparking fierce opposition debate in a marathon June session of Parliament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Quebec student protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: Months of demonstrations against tuition hikes paralyze Montreal in the spring before a September election topples the Liberals.

sport.headline: Canada's quiet London Olympics
sport.summary: Canadians win 18 medals but just one gold at the Summer Games in July and August.

geopolitical_news.headline: Senate expenses scandal widens
geopolitical_news.summary: Audits expose improper claims; Harper's office faces a cover-up scandal as senators are suspended in the fall.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rob Ford crack scandal
geopolitical_news.summary: Toronto's mayor admits smoking crack in November after months of denials; council strips his powers.

sport.headline: Leafs' epic Game 7 collapse
sport.summary: Toronto blows a 4-1 third-period lead to Boston in May in the playoffs' first round.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliament Hill attack
geopolitical_news.summary: October gunman kills a soldier at the War Memorial, then storms Parliament before being shot dead.

geopolitical_news.headline: Lac-Mégantic trial begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Rail disaster prosecutions open as the town still rebuilds from 2013 after the deadly derailment.

sport.headline: Sochi gold rush for Canada
sport.summary: Canada wins 10 golds in February; the women's hockey team beats the US in overtime.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trudeau wins Liberal majority
geopolitical_news.summary: October election ends nine years of Harper; Trudeau promises sunny ways with a stunning majority.

geopolitical_news.headline: Canada welcomes Syrian refugees
geopolitical_news.summary: Ottawa resettles tens of thousands fleeing the war by early 2016 in a celebrated airlift.

sport.headline: Blue Jays end playoff drought
sport.summary: Toronto returns to the postseason in October after 22 years; Bautista's bat flip electrifies.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fort McMurray wildfire evacuates city
geopolitical_news.summary: May blaze forces 80,000 to flee as flames engulf neighborhoods; it becomes Canada's costliest disaster.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trudeau's first year on world stage
geopolitical_news.summary: New PM charms summits while approving pipelines and a carbon price amid high expectations at home.

sport.headline: Oleksiak stars at Rio Games
sport.summary: Penny Oleksiak wins four medals; Canada posts its best Summer haul in decades with 22 total.

geopolitical_news.headline: Canada 150 celebrations
geopolitical_news.summary: Sesquicentennial festivities draw millions across the country throughout the year, shadowed by reconciliation debates with Indigenous communities.

geopolitical_news.headline: NAFTA renegotiation begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Trump's demands put Canada's trade on edge as talks open in August, with autos and dairy at stake.

sport.headline: Penguins repeat as champions
sport.summary: Crosby wins a second straight Conn Smythe in June as Pittsburgh defends the Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: USMCA deal reached
geopolitical_news.summary: October agreement replaces NAFTA after bruising talks with Washington, preserving tariff-free auto trade for now.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cannabis legalized nationwide
geopolitical_news.summary: October legalization makes Canada the second country to legalize recreational marijuana after a century of prohibition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Saudi dispute erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Riyadh expels Canada's ambassador in August over a human rights tweet, freezing trade and flights.

sport.headline: Humboldt Broncos bus crash
sport.summary: April crash in Saskatchewan kills 16 junior hockey players and staff, grieving the nation and prompting an outpouring of support.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trudeau wins minority government
geopolitical_news.summary: October election delivers a minority; the Liberals lose the popular vote to the Conservatives but keep power.

geopolitical_news.headline: SNC-Lavalin scandal dogs PM
geopolitical_news.summary: Ethics commissioner finds in August that Trudeau improperly pressed his attorney general over a Quebec firm's prosecution.

sport.headline: Raptors win the NBA title
sport.summary: Toronto beats Golden State in June for Canada's first NBA championship as Kawhi Leonard earns Finals MVP.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 locks down Canada
geopolitical_news.summary: March shutdowns close borders and businesses as cases surge; Ottawa rolls out massive aid.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nova Scotia mass shooting
geopolitical_news.summary: April rampage kills 22 over 13 terrifying hours in the deadliest shooting in Canadian history.

sport.headline: Canada hosts NHL playoff bubbles
sport.summary: Toronto and Edmonton stage the Stanley Cup playoffs in sealed bubbles through the summer.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trudeau wins second minority
geopolitical_news.summary: September snap election changes little after a 36-day campaign; the Liberals govern with NDP support.

geopolitical_news.headline: Unmarked graves shock the country
geopolitical_news.summary: Kamloops discovery of 215 graves in May forces a reckoning with residential schools and church-state legacy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly heat dome grips BC
geopolitical_news.summary: June heat wave shatters records and kills hundreds in British Columbia before wildfires follow across the province.

sport.headline: Record haul at Tokyo Olympics
sport.summary: Canada wins 24 medals, its best ever at a non-boycotted Summer Games, led by swimmer Maggie Mac Neil.

geopolitical_news.headline: Freedom Convoy paralyzes Ottawa
geopolitical_news.summary: Trucker protests occupy the capital in January and February over vaccine mandates until police clear them.

geopolitical_news.headline: Emergencies Act invoked
geopolitical_news.summary: Trudeau uses emergency powers in February for the first time to end the blockades.

sport.headline: Canada qualifies for the World Cup
sport.summary: The men reach Qatar 2022, ending a 36-year World Cup drought by topping CONCACAF qualifying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Foreign interference inquiry launched
geopolitical_news.summary: Allegations of Chinese meddling in elections force a public inquiry in September amid opposition pressure.

geopolitical_news.headline: Record wildfire season
geopolitical_news.summary: Fires burn vast areas and blanket cities in smoke through the summer, forcing thousands to evacuate.

sport.headline: McDavid's 153-point season
sport.summary: Connor McDavid posts the NHL's highest scoring season in decades with 64 goals for Edmonton in 2022-23.

geopolitical_news.headline: Liberals bleed support
geopolitical_news.summary: Byelection losses and caucus revolt leave Trudeau's future in doubt through a bruising year as polls collapse.

geopolitical_news.headline: Foreign interference report released
geopolitical_news.summary: A June report details foreign states' meddling in Canadian elections, naming China and India chiefly.

sport.headline: McIntosh shines at Paris Games
sport.summary: Summer McIntosh wins three golds in the pool; Canada takes a record 27 medals.

geopolitical_news.headline: Carney becomes PM, wins election
geopolitical_news.summary: Mark Carney replaces Trudeau in March, then wins April's election as Liberals surge on anti-Trump sentiment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump tariffs batter Canada
geopolitical_news.summary: US tariffs and 51st-state taunts strain the cross-border relationship through a bruising trade fight in 2025.

sport.headline: Canada beats US in 4 Nations final
sport.summary: McDavid's overtime winner seals a 3-2 victory over the Americans in February's championship in Boston.
